translate_en|mods/KDOT/42/media/lua/shar: Global setting. Applies to all vehicle spawns. Percent chance a vehicle spawns fully burnt out, pulled from the game's own burnt vehicle list.

Global setting. Applies to all vehicle spawns. Chance any given part on a vehicle spawns already damaged, even on normal-looking vehicles. This is how vehicles end up lightly damaged but still driveable.
Boosts the global spawn rate of ambient trailers (driveways, farms, parking lots) to reach this target percentage. Set to 0 to safely disable this feature and revert to default spawn weights.
Global setting. Applies to all vehicle spawns. Chance of finding a key for a vehicle, on the ground, in the car, or carried by a random nearby zombie.
Global setting. Applies to all vehicle spawns. When a part spawns damaged, this caps how good its condition can be. Lower means more severely damaged parts.
Global setting. Only applies Vanilla vehicle spawns. What percent use a pre-made wreck (smashed) model instead of a normal-looking one.
Global setting. Applies to all vehicle spawns. Chance of a special vehicle, such as police, fire, ambulance or military vehicles appearing.

Global setting. Of all vehicles spawned anywhere on the map, not just traffic jams, but crashes, roadblocks, and everyday parked/driving vehicles too. What percent are vanilla vehicles vs vehicles from other installed vehicle mods. 100 means vanilla only, 0 means modded vehicles only. If no vehicle mods are installed, vanilla is always used regardless of this setting.
